conventions.value: mat-* materials | lx-* learning experiences | act-* activities | prj-* projects | out-* outputs | int-* interests | goal-* goals | ms-* milestones | ev-* evidence | ins-* insights | ext-* external records | per-* periods | cor-* corrections
qualitative only: high | moderate | low | unknown. No numeric scores anywhere; a percentage appears only where the user measured something themselves (grasp success rate).
A direct user input | B learning activity | C learning evidence | D creative output | E system observation | F external source. Taxonomy from docs/architecture/trajectory-inputs.md
user | system | external_platform | agent. Answers 'who said this', which is not the same as which surface it arrived on.
stated (the user said it) | observed (the system saw it happen) | inferred (the system concluded it) | imported (came from outside)
true if trajectory_service.py can read a row for it today; false means the entity exists in the person's life but not in the product.
All relations are explicit id arrays in both directions where it matters. An entity may appear in several dimensions at once; nothing is forced into one owner.

activities carry source (A|B|C|D|F) + learned (yes|no|partial|unknown) + visible, instead of a full provenance block; they are one-off events, not objects. visible=true only when the event left text inside the product (note / reflecting / discussion / problem).
foc-* = organisational perspective over a period (has from/to, may be absorbed). Not a subtype of interest, not a container for activities. An activity may carry 0, 1 or several.

relations between an evidence item and an insight: supports | weakens | contradicts | qualifies | inconclusive. One evidence may hit several insights with different polarity; an evidence may hit none at all.

augmentation.why: 上一轮自评发现四个缺口：活动没有 focus、没有高密度时段、证据关系太顺、时间只有一种。
augmentation.marker: every record added in this round carries "added_in": "aug-2"
augmentation.focus_is_not_interest: foc-* is a period-scoped perspective. int-* is a durable interest. They overlap but neither contains the other; foc-04 has no interest at all.
augmentation.zero_focus_meaning: an activity without a "focus" field was never assessed against this dimension; an activity with "focus": [] was considered and belongs to none. The dataset keeps both.
augmentation.time_fields: ts = when it happened (as recorded, may be wrong) · recorded_at = when Lemma received it · revision_time = when the record was edited · effective_from/to = when an interpretation applied. Only used where it means something.
